messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Suspicious credential-mirroring activity detected from svc-indexer to external S3 endpoint (s3://unknown-exfil). Sampled 872 requests in last 5m, ~98% 200 responses. Root ts=2111110000

alice.ops: seeing the alert, pulling logs now. which region?

pagerbot: region=us-west-2, source service=svc-indexer-prod-3, sample_ips=[18.205.0.1, 34.210.2.9], possible exfil pattern: repeated HEAD/PUT to s3-like endpoints.

ben.oncall: ack - I'm on call. Alice, leave logs; I'll start containment.

carol.secops: joining. quick question: do we know if any customer PII surfaced? eve-cs pls stand by for comms.

alice.ops: grep shows indexer forwarded archived logs to a non-whitelisted host at 18.205.0.1. snippet: ```
2026-07-12T18:10:02Z svc-indexer-prod-3 PUT /archive/2026/07/12/seg-334.log host: unknown-exfil 200 user=svc-indexer role=svcacct-indexer
```

ben.oncall: running quick check: `aws s3 ls s3://unknown-exfil --region us-west-2` -> access denied from our CLI, but traffic shows service account creds were used.

carol.secops: likely service account key compromise or misconfig. Start by rotating svcacct-indexer keys and revoke existing tokens. Also block those external IPs at the egress layer.

ben.oncall: on it. Steps I'm executing now:
1) add IP block on egress firewall: `fwctl block 18.205.0.1/32 34.210.2.9/32`
2) create rotated creds: `rbacctl rotate-key svcacct-indexer --immediate` (will push to KMS)
3) deploy temporary deny policy for svc-indexer: `iamctl attach-policy svc-indexer deny-s3-put-external`

alice.ops: confirming `fwctl` applied, traffic to 18.205.0.1 dropped at edge. seeing drop in tcpdump on host.

carol.secops: good. Ben, after you rotate, revoke all sessions for svcacct-indexer and invalidate caches (KV). We'll also run a rapid scan for other services using same creds.

ben.oncall: rotation in progress. new keys generated and stored in KMS. Issuing revoke: `sessionsctl revoke --principal svcacct-indexer --all`

pagerbot: notification: key rotation job started by ben.oncall at 2111110155; status=IN_PROGRESS.

eve-cs: tagging in customer success. we need to assess customer impact: any 5xx responses? any customer-facing API errors?

alice.ops: quick telemetry shows no customer-facing 5xx spike; indexer is internal pipeline. impact likely limited to archived logs. Still checking which log buckets were forwarded.

carol.secops: run `logq \"host: unknown-exfil\" --last 24h --fields bucket,path,user` and paste results. Also snapshot who had access to svcacct-indexer keys in last 7d.

alice.ops: results (top 3):
```
bucket: logs-archive-prod, path: /2026/07/12/seg-334.log, user: svc-indexer
bucket: logs-archive-prod, path: /2026/07/11/seg-128.log, user: svc-indexer
bucket: logs-intake-staging, path: /2026/07/12/seg-002.log, user: svc-indexer
```

carol.secops: ok. escalate if any bucket contains PII. Eve, please prepare a tentative customer notice template but hold for legal review. Include: what happened, what we rotated, mitigation steps, and contact for follow-up.

eve-cs: will draft and share in #legal-review. ETA 30m.

ben.oncall: rotation complete at 2111110220. Sessions revoked, caches cleared, service restarted with new creds. Monitoring for retries.

pagerbot: key rotation job completed (successful) at 2111110220. Post-rotation auth attempts to unknown-exfil fell to 0.

alice.ops: running content-scan on the forwarded objects we could enumerate. so far metadata only; pulling down a sample object (sanitized) for review. attaching hash: sha256=abc123...

carol.secops: if sample contains PII, we escalate to legal and consider customer notification and potential regulator reporting. Also run a search for any other service where svcacct-indexer creds were used (look for `user=svc-indexer` in access logs across all regions).

ben.oncall: started broad hunt across regions. current progress 45%. will post results.

alice.ops: note: we found an automation job that had the old key stored in plain text in a helper script on a build host. raising follow-up: secure-secret-scan and rotate other service keys that used same pattern.

carol.secops: mitigation checklist updated: block IPs, rotate keys, revoke sessions, audit secret storage, scan objects for PII, CS+legal review. Marking severity=P2 for now (internal logs exfil, no confirmed PII yet).

ben.oncall: handing off to night on-call (dave-oncall) for monitoring and follow-up. Handoff checklist posted below. dave, please ACK and continue hunt if I don't respond.

alice.ops: handoff notes:
- rotation done, sessions revoked
- egress blocks applied (18.205.0.1, 34.210.2.9)
- sample objects pulled, currently sanitized --> guardrails on disclosure
- CS drafting comms, legal in queue
- follow-up items: secret-scan across infra, verify S3 bucket permissions, run daily audit for 7 days

ben.oncall: tagging dave-oncall: @dave-oncall please ACK.

dave-oncall: ACK. I'll monitor until 0400 PT and escalate to carol if new exfil or reattempts appear. Also will run full secret-scan overnight and update in morning.

carol.secops: thanks all. after morning findings, we'll decide if severity needs bump and if we notify customers/regulators. For now, continue 15m checks for any outbound PUTs to unknown hosts.

eve-cs: drafted customer notice (internal draft) and uploaded to #legal-review. cc: @carol-secops @alice.ops.

pagerbot: scheduled follow-up check at 2111110820 (1h).

ben.oncall: leaving channel, reach me if escalation. great work. :thumbsup:

alice.ops: small follow-up: opened ticket INF-3738 to track remediation and root-cause (helper script secret in repo). adding owners and ETA 3d.

carol.secops: closing triage phase. Handoff complete.

pagerbot: THREAD CLOSED by carol.secops at 2111110420 (triage->monitoring).
